Title: Keyboard focus visibility
Requirement: All interactive controls expose a visible keyboard focus state
Notes: Validated with keyboard-only navigation during regression run.

Title: Color contrast in challenge charts
Requirement: Chart labels and bars meet minimum color contrast ratio
Notes: Some legend values fail 4.5:1 ratio on dark mode.
RemediationGuidance: Adjust chart palette and add high-contrast mode token mapping.

Title: Screen reader announcements for script execution status
Requirement: Execution status updates are announced to assistive technologies
Notes: Dependent on third-party terminal component update.
RemediationGuidance: Introduce aria-live region wrapper once component supports status hooks.

Title: Portal accessibility baseline assessment
Requirement: Complete baseline accessibility assessment before production launch
Notes: Initial assessment planned after portal information architecture is finalized.
RemediationGuidance: Run axe-core and manual WCAG walkthrough for all key journeys.
